title: LumiBase anonymous usage telemetry event (v1)
description: The complete body of every request the opt-in telemetry emitter sends. Nothing else is transmitted.

installId.description: Random UUID v4 generated on the install when telemetry is first enabled. Not derived from any hostname, key, user or site.

occurredOn.description: UTC calendar day the milestone was reached (YYYY-MM-DD). No time of day.
